And then what they will do is with this common language, they will start to tell each other stories of where they come from. And these stories will become a common myth, a founding myth of why they're here. They come to believe that God has chosen them to save the world and that's why they're there.

Then what they will do is develop rituals to reinforce this new religion. These rituals include sex. The reason for this is to create intimacy and bonding among them. There will be a lot of religious rituals as well. Another thing they will do is pick a leader.

There are 100 of them, so they need a leader to organize them. During the leadership election, everyone gets up to speak. The man who's 65 years old is wise, experienced, and strategic. He delivers a very powerful speech inspiring everyone and telling people how they can survive against the flash-eating monkeys.

Suddenly, there's a young man, around 15 or 16 years old, who stands in front of everyone boldly without saying a word. He shows them his hand, then takes out a knife from his pocket and cuts off his hand in front of everyone. He does not cry; he just looks at everyone as though nothing happened.

Who do you think everyone picks to be their leader? The second person obviously, the man who has shown sacrifice and commitment and devotion to everyone else. The old man becomes the advisor to the leader because he has ideas, but the leader is the one most willing to die for everyone else. Therefore, the bravest among them emerges as the leader.

These people become extremely inspired and devoted. Even though they are weak, they learn to become strong. Even though they are poor and uneducated, they learn to be wise, clever, and strategic. They radically transform themselves. Ultimately, this leads to cohesion like brothers or a family. They understand each other even better than their own children and wives.

This cohesion results in something called synchronicity. Synchronicity is when people act in unison together. A simple example of synchronicity is a sports team working together because of their minds being alike, creating a hive mind that allows for telepathy. For instance, if one person wonders off to collect wood and gets attacked by monkeys, his comrades would know he's in danger even from far away.

Another example: If you have a child who goes on vacation but is hospitalized without calling you, something in your heart tells you that they are in danger. You would feel it and try to reach them, showing how the hive mind works.

Let’s say 10 of you are collecting wood, and suddenly a hundred flesh-eating monkeys attack. Nine get across the bridge, but you’re the last one. If the monkeys descend on you, your comrades’ lives depend on you getting across safely.
